acceptanceCriteria: Fixture repository with 20,000 tracked files: `docs corpus manifest --schema 2 --scope a --scope b` produces one /2 manifest with both scopes and 20,000 inputs, and `docs corpus build` accepts it.
The refusal for a scope above the /2 bound reports the bound and actual count.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#1241 (filed 2026-10-19 against build main-fa8afe6). `corvint docs corpus manifest --scope PATH` refuses any scope that contains more than 4,096 tracked files (`empty or oversized scope`) and always writes a `corvint-corpus-input/1` manifest with a single scope. The `corvint-corpus-input/2` build path accepts up to 100,000 records, so a producer with a medium repository must split the tree into many small scopes, run the command once per scope, and merge the manifests by hand into a /2 manifest.
title: docs corpus manifest: emit /2 manifests with multiple scopes and the /2 bound (GitHub #1241)
